title: Ginger (Dry): modeled ₹628/qtl left, Dhanotu (Mandi) → Bhuntar
summary: February 2022: reported ginger (Dry) prices at Dhanotu (Mandi) and Bhuntar imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 96% of 23 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹628 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 20 same-variety market pairs screened for ginger (Dry) in February 2022; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Bhuntar report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: February 2022
scenes.caption: Dhanotu (Mandi) (Himachal Pradesh) and Bhuntar (Himachal Pradesh) both reported ginger (Dry) prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 23 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Dhanotu (Mandi) reported a median ₹3,250 per quintal. Bhuntar reported a median ₹4,200 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹1,000/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹1,000 per quintal, and Bhuntar was dearer on 96% of days.

scenes.headline: 127 km by road
scenes.caption: 127 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~3 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹27/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹554 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹320 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Bhuntar report, the rule selects 22 of 23 modeled shipping days. 21 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹628 per quintal (₹401 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Ginger (Dry) route from Dhanotu (Mandi) to Bhuntar was positive on 96% of matched days in February 2022. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹62,800, or ₹40,100 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to ginger (Dry)
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹27/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Ginger (Dry) route from Dhanotu (Mandi) to Bhuntar was positive on 96% of matched days in February 2022. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹62,800, or ₹40,100 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

RBI Working Paper WPS (DEPR) 08/2024 — Price Dynamics of Tomato, Onion and Potato
